433: If your damage dealer does not have any issues surviving, then rolling the 2 other subslots into magical / physical damage increase depending on your damage type (ignore this if your DPS uses neutral damage) can provide better quality of life.
434: For primary options, LS on damage dealers have the most impact when it comes to survivability as it is essentially a second passive, then followed by offensive options (CC, CD). Armor and Resis main stats may benefit tanks and buffers that scale from it, whereas HA main stat can primarly benefit healers and buffers that scale from it.
435:
COLOSSEUM ONLY RINGS ALSO WORK IN ARENA. If you didn't know, now you do.

The only difference that sets ring recommendations apart from arena to colosseum is that, resu rings does not work in arena. Therefore, the following points should be used as reference for arena from a survivability perspective:
436: 1. CR rings > DR rings in all cases, unless the opponent you are going up against cannot crit anyway (Skadi)
437: 2. Heroes that focuses on stacking Evasion should always use Eva ring above all else.
438: However, arena isn't just about survivability. After all, assassinating certain threats before they murder you is also of utmost importance, seeing as these would have no counter otherwise.
439: This means that heroes that employ the "kill them before they kill you" strategy (often fast, bursty, tank ignore damage dealers) would prefer rings with physical / magical damage increase or Accuracy to ensure you can effectively carry out this strategy.
441:
Given how hard the boss hits and how the boss has effectively no Armor or Resistance, you will want 6* rings with 3 DR lines on every single one of your heroes. No exceptions even on your DPS.

On your DPSes, there are only three types you can choose. A 3 line DR ring with LS main stat, a LS resu ring, or a Two-Dimensional Potential ring with 2 LS sub options.

The first is the general use option for DPSes.

The second will be optimal if your DPS tends to only die in the last level.

The third is typically used for maximizing damage potential, especially if damage is a bigger issue than survival AND if you do not have enough CC.

These will significantly enhance the survivability of your DPSes.
442:
After all that information, as a beginner, what kind of rings should you hunt for?

It is generally a good idea to prioritize obtaining a ring with some accuracy subslots to reach the challenge accuracy requirement. Math out how much you need yourself depending on what DPSes you are running.

Otherwise, beginners should prioritize hunting for resu rings as a long term objective. However, if you obtain a ring with 2 Apen / Rpen subslots or with 2 accuracy subslots, it is a good idea to reroll the slot that is not the same as the previous two to complete a ring with 3 penetration / accuracy subslots.

Once you have reached end game, these will be of incredible help in challenge and arena, as well as in events such as ordeal and Hasla War. This advice is also applicable to other ring options, where it is recommended to keep any rings you get with 2 or more of the same slots (or any ring with combinations of Apen / Rpen and Accuracy) as they may be of use in the future. You can eventually reroll the last line into a 3 line ring you want.

This is especially applicable to DR, where you will need 12, yes 12, 3 line 6* DR rings for stable Total War clears.

5* penetration rings are as good as useless end game wise, seeing as not having the maximum upgrades can immensely affect your damage output due to Armor and Resistance's hyperbolic growth; it should be rather clear if you paid attention to CQ Maths 101.

Speaking of HP... Manacar HP options are in the triple digits at max, whereas LoPF HP% options only work on training stats (no inheritance, no berry, no sigils). That sounds totally useful, am I right?

十二生肖联动第二季的限定角色，定位是PVP坦克。技能设计乍一看很强，高减攻高减伤高回避，但实际上减攻debuff不穿坦，自身又缺少抗性提升容易被单项属性伤害打死，高减伤看似美妙，但实际上减伤的极限也就80%而已，还是需要和抗性buff配合才能做到有坦度。
在PVP中，由于猪的减攻击是5个1秒结合而成的debuff，因此在搭配舒布时可以让触手不断的拍击，同时猪也能提供不断的击退和晕眩，但成也击退败也击退，此击退同样不穿坦，在实战中往往只能推走敌方坦克，但激光+被动推人也无法将物理绝壁狮子假面推出擂台，且击退力度较大，容易坑自家输出（尤其是搭配李时最为明显，扇子击中敌方后基本不再向前，然后猪一个激光就推开了导致空干），因此在阵容的搭配上最好选择可以冲阵的角色如鲸鱼/该隐等等。
但猪的主要属性是强调生存与防守，这让猪的各种配队都难以突破拥有极强战场能力的海洋星奶+伽罗尼卡的经典组合（旗子可以收盾，狮子假面在非海洋期间可以晕到对手没有办法施放技能获得buff）,且猪在面对西门时，虽然对手不带坦可以给西门施放减攻debuff，但西门的爆炸伤害依然是三拳之内即可解决猪猪，这让猪的减攻击只能收割残局和触发舒布上有施展空间了。

总体而言，猪这个角色还是非常不错的防守坦克，虽然与CQ的两位T0坦克狮子假面和旗子存在较大差距，但其强调生存和防守的能力还是很出色的，若无两位T0坦克还是非常值得培养的。虽然比国王强，但远远比不上旗子狮子。

猪的任意消都会哭5秒，同时伴随减攻击力的debuff，且是1秒+1秒+1秒+1秒+1秒=5秒的减攻击debuff，同时每0.95秒刷新一次，这也就意味着猪可以不断触发舒布的拍打。
**但比较可惜的是，猪的减攻击是不穿坦的。**

猪开始哭后就会坦伤5秒，进入坦伤后被晕眩看起来虽然是终止了哭泣动画，但实际上**猪还在坦伤**，但如果猪被晕了5秒以上的话，会因为被晕到无法响应消块动作而被迫断坦，也就是俗称可以被晕到断坦。

为什么要提到晕到断坦这种特殊手法呢，**因为猪的坦伤是不可被解除的**。
